verdict: Lead flow stalled this week; overdue campaign launches are being resolved now.
narrative: You received 16 leads over the last 28 days at $105.51 per lead, but the most recent 7 days produced zero leads on a reduced daily spend of $48 — a direct result of a 50% cut to Google Ads budget that left your top-performing campaign under-funded and Google dark for three of the last four days. At the same time, several planned campaign launches — including heating and furnace ads that were due October 1 and an LSA re-enable due September 1 — have not yet gone live, which has compounded the slowdown heading into heating season. We are moving to restore budget, launch the overdue heating campaigns, and re-enable Local Services Ads now. Once those are live, you should see lead volume recover and cost per lead stabilize over the next two to three weeks.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 7 days, down from the prior 7-day period
leads received over the full 28-day period at $105.51 each
planned milestones overdue, including heating campaign launches now being prioritized

watch_item.issue: Two Google Business Profile listings — Quality HVAC Solutions and Quality HVAC by Fibid — are generating strong impression volume (891 and 238 respectively this period) but converting calls at only 1.2%, well below what your third profile achieves.
watch_item.fix: Profile content and call-to-action elements on both listings are being reviewed and updated this week to close that gap.
